job.title: [Post] Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud 📌 Employment Type: Contract / 2PM to ...

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Technical Lead – Java, Spring, APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and headless commerce. Proven record designing and integrating PIM/ERP/MDM data pipelines, optimizing database performance, and leading CI/CD deployments in Docker/Kubernetes environments. Skilled techno-functional consultant translating business requirements into robust solutions, with extensive Agile experience and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to shape your Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud strategy, leveraging my 5+ years of senior SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My deep experience in headless e-commerce, API design, and large-scale integrations aligns perfectly with the technical leadership this role demands.

bullets.label: Platform Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and delivered backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring and microservices, driving high-performance e-commerce experiences.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST Web Services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub, Hotfolders and Profisee, ensuring seamless product data synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional capacity, I gathered business requirements, authored user stories and functional specs, and guided international stakeholders through solution design and production support.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Ops
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, automating releases and maintaining robust cloud operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit, I am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Your commitment to delivering innovative, scalable B2C commerce solutions on the Salesforce platform resonates with my passion for building high-performance e-commerce systems. I am drawn to your global client portfolio and the opportunity to work remotely with a forward-thinking team that values AI-assisted development and continuous delivery—areas where I have demonstrated measurable impact.
tailoring.motivation_short: Join your team to apply my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, API integration skills, and techno-functional leadership to drive cutting-edge Salesforce B2C Commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering large e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to bring my API, integration and leadership experience to your Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Technical Lead role. Open to discuss further.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Technical Lead
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Technical Lead position. With over five years of senior SAP Commerce Cloud development, extensive API integration, and proven technical leadership, I am confident I can add immediate value to your team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
